FieldReady Academy

CRES Study Guide and Practice Tests

CRES Academy is a free study guide and practice-test course for the AAMI/ACI Certified Radiology Equipment Specialist exam. Sixty lessons follow the exam's six domains, a printable CRES cheat sheet collects the dose limits, formulas, QC tolerances, and network tools worth memorizing, adaptive tutorials rebuild from your misses, and unlimited CRES practice tests draw on a bank of original CRES exam questions built from the exam's domain weights.

How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 165 questions in 180 minutes, at its real passing score of 70%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

Questions people ask

How many questions are on the CRES exam?

165 multiple-choice questions in 3 hours, closed book, with an on-screen calculator and notepad. ACI sets the cut score with a criterion-referenced method and does not publish it; this course's official-format test uses 70%.

When is the CRES offered?

Twice a year, May 1 to 15 and November 1 to 15, at Kryterion computer-based test centers. Applications open about three months before each window.

Who is eligible for the CRES?

Full certification needs an associate degree in electronics, technology, or science plus two years of full-time BMET work, or a US military biomed program plus two years, or four years of full-time work alone, and at least 40 percent of that work in radiology over the last two years with 25 percent over the last five. Candidate status is open with the degree, the military program, or two years of work alone.

How much does the CRES cost?

In 2026 the exam is $410 for AAMI members and $460 for non-members; a retake is $355 or $405. In 2027 the fees rise to $425 and $480. Certification is renewed every three years with continuing education.

How many practice tests should I take?

This course asks for three of your last five fifty-question practice tests at 80% or better, then one full-length test in the real exam's format at the real passing score.

Is the course free?

Yes. The lessons, the cheat sheet, and unlimited practice tests are free while the site launches.

What is on the Certified Radiology Equipment Specialist CRES exam?

Anatomy and Physiology (7%), Public Safety in the Healthcare Facility (8%), Fundamentals of Electricity and Electronics (10%), Healthcare Technology and Function (25%), Healthcare Technology Problem Solving (25%), Healthcare Information Technology (25%). The course's units follow the same domains, and the practice tests draw on the same domain weights.
